providers.bitbucket.area_help: That's how Bitbucket groups your organization's code — over there they're called projects.
providers.bitbucket.field.space.help: The short name that shows up in the web address, after bitbucket.org/
providers.bitbucket.field.space.label: Your workspace name
providers.bitbucket.field.space.missing: Your workspace name is missing: the short name that shows up in the web address, after bitbucket.org/
providers.bitbucket.login_help: Bitbucket doesn't let you approve this from the browser, so the token is pasted by hand. In exchange, it's created read-only and works for the whole workspace.
providers.bitbucket.token_help: In Bitbucket, go to your workspace settings, open "Access tokens" and create one ticking only the Read permissions for "Repositories", "Projects" and "Pull requests". The last one enables PR and review queries. With that, this app sees all your projects and repositories without being able to change anything. It isn't a person's token: it belongs to the workspace, and whoever administers it can expire or revoke it whenever they want.
providers.error.area_required: This repository is outside this workspace’s organizations. Add its organization in Settings → GitHub.
providers.error.branches_connected: I couldn't list that repository's branches. Check that your connection still has access to it.
providers.error.branches_public: I couldn't list that repository's branches. Check the address and that it's public.
providers.error.clone_connected: I couldn't fetch that repository. Check that your connection still has access to it.
providers.error.clone_public: I couldn't fetch that repository. Check the address, and that it's public: with no connection there's nothing to ask permission with.
providers.error.data_dir: I couldn't open the app's data folder. Reopen the app and try again.
providers.error.fetch_updates: I couldn't fetch what's new in that repository. Check that your connection still has access to it.
providers.error.login_cancelled: The connection was cancelled. Start over whenever you like.
providers.error.login_timeout: Too much time passed waiting for the permission in {name}. Start over.
providers.error.no_branches: That repository has no branch I can fetch.
providers.error.no_browser_login: {name} doesn't let you approve this from the browser.
providers.error.no_default_branch: I couldn't tell which the main branch is. Check that the repository has a main branch configured.
providers.error.no_git: I couldn't find git on this computer.
providers.error.no_git_bundled: I couldn't find git on this computer and the one I bring couldn't be set up either.
providers.error.no_pending_login: There's no half-finished connection with {name}. Start over.
providers.error.not_connected: You haven't connected {name} yet. Connect it up here and try again.
providers.error.token_lost: {name} needs to be connected again: this computer can no longer open its saved credential.
providers.error.pr_unreadable_url: I couldn't tell which repository this is from its address, so I didn't open the pull request. The branch was published: you can open it from the web.
providers.error.save_connection_disk: I couldn't save the connection on this computer. Check that the app has permission to write in its data folder.
providers.error.token_missing: The token is missing. Create it in {name} and paste it here.
providers.error.unknown_provider: That provider doesn't exist in this version of the app.
providers.github.area_help: Your account and the organizations this connection reaches. Through the GitHub button, only the ones where you installed Danil.
providers.github.error.denied: The permission wasn't granted in GitHub. If that was by accident, start over.
providers.github.error.device_refused: GitHub wouldn't open the permission for this app. Connect it by pasting a token in the meantime.
providers.github.error.expired: Too much time passed and GitHub cancelled the permission. Start over.
providers.github.error.installation_gone: Danil is no longer installed on “{account}”. Install it there again, or pick another account.
providers.github.error.no_client_id: This copy of the app has no permission configured to open the GitHub login.
providers.github.error.no_client_id_hint: This copy of the app has no permission configured to open the GitHub login. Connect it by pasting a token in the meantime.
providers.github.error.no_installations: You authorized Danil, but it is not installed on any account yet. Install it at {url} and choose which repositories it reaches.
providers.github.error.outside_area: This repository is outside the access selected for {account}. Review the organization and its repositories in Settings → GitHub.
providers.github.error.unfinished: GitHub didn't finish granting the permission. Start over, or connect it by pasting a token.
providers.github.login_help.browser: Your browser opens with your own session and you approve there — nothing to paste. Then you choose which account Danil is installed on, and which repositories it reaches.
providers.github.login_help.paste: This copy of the app can't open the GitHub login for you yet, so here the token is pasted by hand. In exchange, you can create it read-only.
providers.github.token_help: It needs read permission for code and for organizations. It's yours and only yours: don't use a shared one from the organization.
providers.http.no_connection: I couldn't reach {name}. Check your connection and try again — if you're on the office network, you may need the VPN.
providers.http.no_read_permission: That token isn't enough to read this. Give it read permission in {name} and connect it again.
providers.http.not_found: {name} didn't find that. Check your organization's short name — it's the one that shows up in the web address, not the long name.
providers.http.rate_limited: {name} is throttling queries for now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
providers.http.rejected_query: {name} rejected the query. Try again; if it keeps happening, check the token.
providers.http.server_error: {name} isn't responding well right now. Try again in a while.
providers.http.timeout: {name} didn't answer in time. Check your connection and try again.
providers.http.token_expired: The connection with {name} stopped working: the token expired or someone revoked it. Create a new one and connect again.
providers.http.token_unknown: {name} doesn't recognize that token. Check that you copied it whole and that it hasn't expired, and paste it again.
providers.http.unreadable: {name} answered something I couldn't read. Try again in a moment.
providers.github.error.confirm_repositor: This GitHub connection comes from an older engine version. Update Danil or choose the account again in Settings → GitHub.

providers.gitlab.summary: Connect with a token, on gitlab.com or your company’s GitLab
providers.gitlab.error.missing_scopes: This token is missing permissions: {scopes}. Create a new one with them checked and paste it again.
providers.gitlab.error.url_invalid: That GitLab address doesn't work. Type your instance's address with https://, for example https://gitlab.yourcompany.com, or leave it empty for gitlab.com.
providers.gitlab.field.url.help: Leave it empty if you use gitlab.com. If your company runs its own GitLab, type its address, for example https://gitlab.yourcompany.com.
providers.gitlab.field.url.label: Your GitLab address
providers.gitlab.login_help: GitLab only allows approving this from the browser with an application registered on each instance, so the token is pasted by hand. In exchange, it's created with read-only permission.
providers.gitlab.token_help: In GitLab, open your avatar → Edit profile → Personal access tokens and create one with read_api and read_repository checked. With that this app sees your groups and projects and clones them without being able to change anything. If you use your company's GitLab, the link below is for gitlab.com: open it on your instance's address.
